title: Neon Snake deployment diagram
description: How Neon Snake runs: one Cloudflare Worker with static assets and no database. The browser runs the whole game.

nodes.name: Player's browser
nodes.description: Runs the Godot web export (WebGL 2, Compatibility renderer) and keeps the best score.

nodes.name: Cloudflare edge
nodes.description: Runs the Worker on icelander.net/games/retro/snake*, ahead of the games hub's route.

nodes.name: snake Worker
nodes.description: worker/index.ts: the sign-in check for the page and the joined engine file; every other path is a static asset from ./dist.

nodes.name: icelander.net login service
nodes.description: accounts.icelander.net, in the icelander.net repository (accounts/): who holds the host's site_session cookie and their games: roles. The Worker reaches it only through a service binding.

artifacts.name: Godot web export
artifacts.description: index.html, index.js, index.pck and the engine as index.wasm.0 and .1 (each under Cloudflare's 25 MiB limit), built by build.mjs.

artifacts.name: boot.js, styles and headers
artifacts.description: The boot script (esbuild), shell.css, favicon.svg and _headers (a strict Content-Security-Policy).

artifacts.name: Worker script
artifacts.description: The fetch handler, bundled by wrangler.

relationships.description: HTTPS: the page, its assets and the engine.
Service binding ACCOUNTS (entrypoint Internal): the game's page needs a signed-in player.
